turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale, I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste either of our time. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him before it went in?
I have until 4:40, Hale, and you haven't answered me yet. Who entered the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in? Either answer that or tell me I'm going to the principal's office next.
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
No. Nothing is resolved, and I won't put my word on a paper you write up yourself. The zero comes off, and I'm writing down that you asked me to agree to it.
No. Withdraw the zero, Hale, and then we'll talk about what "okay" means.
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
I heard you the first three times, Hale. You haven't shown me a single document, and you want my signature on "resolved." Is there something on paper, or am I going upstairs?
